7 Brew Cloud 9 Matcha Latte: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Cloud 9 Matcha Latte is about $4.65, with 310 calories, 17 mg of caffeine and 55 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Cloud 9 Matcha Latte allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Cloud 9 Matcha Latte. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Cloud 9 Matcha Latte

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Cloud 9 Matcha Latte?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Cloud 9 Matcha Latte at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Lavender is strong. Measure it instead of free-pouring, or the drink turns into perfume. The stand-style method from fans who replicate it: make a matcha concentrate, then build over milk.

For one medium Cloud 9 Matcha Latte

  • 2 teaspoons matcha powder (about 4 g)
  • 2 oz hot water (about 175°F) for whisking, or 4 oz of matcha concentrate
  • 1/2 oz lavender syrup
  • 1/2 oz vanilla syrup
  • About 10 oz whole milk
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Whisk the matcha and hot water until smooth and frothy.
  2. Stir the lavender and vanilla into the milk in your glass.
  3. Fill with ice, pour the matcha over the top, and stir gently.

Extra sweet, the popular order: add 1/2 oz simple syrup or cane sugar syrup. Floral too much? Cut the lavender to 1/4 oz and keep the vanilla at 1/2 oz. The vanilla is the base note, the lavender is the accent. Milk note: whole milk is the stand default per fan reports; oat makes it sweeter, almond makes the matcha louder.

7 Brew Cloud 9 Matcha Latte FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Cloud 9 Matcha Latte?

A medium iced Cloud 9 Matcha Latte has 310 calories. A small has 230 and a large 400, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Cloud 9 Matcha Latte?

About 17 mg in a medium. Small is 11 mg and large is 22 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Cloud 9 Matcha Latte cost?

Roughly $3.95 for a small, $4.65 for a medium and $5.45 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Cloud 9 Matcha Latte?

55 g in a medium.

What is in a Cloud 9 Matcha Latte?

Lavender and vanilla. Every source agrees on the pair: lavender syrup and vanilla syrup in a matcha latte with whole milk. It is not toasted marshmallow, that is the Cereal Milk Matcha. Fans describe the taste as soft and floral, and more than one compares it to Froot Loops milk. The matcha base itself already has cane sugar in it before the syrups go in.

Is Cloud 9 a flavor or just this drink?

A flavor. Cloud 9 shows up across the 7 Brew menu: there is a Cloud 9 Earl Grey tea, and fans order Cloud 9 energies, fizzes and lemonades too. Everywhere it appears, it means the same lavender plus vanilla pairing. This page covers the matcha latte version.

Is there a sugar-free Cloud 9 Matcha Latte?

The official guide lists no sugar-free version. One ranking page hedges that it 'depends on location' because sugar-free vanilla and lavender syrups exist. A stand might build you one, but there is no official sugar-free Cloud 9 in the guide and no official numbers for it. The regular medium iced is 310 calories and 55 g of sugar, and the pre-sweetened matcha base sets a floor under any custom version. The drinks that do come sugar-free, all 43 of them, are compared on our sugar-free page.

How does Cloud 9 compare to Cereal Milk Matcha?

Same calories, different mood. A medium iced of either is 310 calories. Cloud 9 is lavender and vanilla: floral, soft, a little perfumed. Cereal Milk is toasted marshmallow and vanilla: sweeter, grainier, like cereal milk. Sugar differs slightly (55 g Cloud 9, 53 g Cereal Milk), and only Cereal Milk has an official sugar-free version.

How do I make a Cloud 9 matcha latte at home?

Whisk matcha with hot water, then pour it over milk mixed with lavender and vanilla syrups and ice. Fans who replicate the stand build make a matcha concentrate first (4 oz of it per drink) with about 1 oz of the two syrups combined. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
